_comment: Provenance for config/ugc_pip_insert.jpg -- the brand/product card composited into every UGC-style ad as a picture-in-picture overlay. Copied per trend into artifacts/{trend_id}/pip_insert.jpg by agents/generate/assembler.py's ensure_pip_asset().

source.kind: Neutral placeholder generated locally with Pillow (scripts/make_placeholder_pip_card.py)
source.content: Cream card, terracotta frame, simple drawn cup glyph and the text from brand_profile.json ad_script.pip_card_caption

why_not_rendered_by_veo: Kept out of every Veo job and composited in post instead, so the brand card is exact and never an invented approximation (see GENERATE.md).
replace_with: Your own brand/product card (JPEG), same file name, roughly square; the assembler scales it to a fixed width.
